items.orig: Novara Media reports that British police arrested at least five journalists under the Terrorism Act while they were covering a protest outside a drone factory owned by Israeli defence company Elbit Systems. The demonstration took place outside UAV Tactical Systems, an Elbit Systems subsidiary. Some of the protesters held signs reading, “I oppose genocide. I support Palestine Action”. Police arrested 35 people at the protest under Section 13 of the Terrorism Act.
